entries.name: artifacts.by_type
entries.sql:
select a.id, a.artifact_type, a.sha256, a.bucket_class, a.storage_bucket,
       a.object_path, a.mission_id, a.created_at
from orchestration.artifact a
where a.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::text is null or a.artifact_type = $1)
order by a.created_at desc, a.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Artifacts of one artifact_type for the current tenant

entries.name: entity.at
entries.sql: select * from api.entity_at($1::uuid, $2::timestamptz, $3::bigint)
entries.title: Facts for one entity at a world time as known at a knowledge seq

entries.name: entity.by_identifier
entries.sql:
select e.id as entity_id, e.kind, e.display_name, e.lifecycle, i.scheme, i.value
from corpus.entity_identifier i
join corpus.entity e on e.id = i.entity_id and e.tenant_id = i.tenant_id
where i.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and i.scheme = $1
  and i.value = $2
entries.title: Find a canonical entity by external identifier scheme and value

entries.name: entity.card
entries.sql: select api.entity_card($1::uuid) as card
entries.title: Current overview of one entity

entries.name: entity.relationships
entries.sql: select * from api.relationships($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::timestamptz, $4::bigint, $5::text)
entries.title: Relationships touching one entity at a world time and knowledge seq

entries.name: entity.resolve
entries.sql: select * from api.resolve_entity($1::text)
entries.title: Find entities by name, alias, or identifier

entries.name: entity.timeline
entries.sql: select * from api.entity_timeline($1::uuid, $2::timestamptz, $3::timestamptz, $4::bigint)
entries.title: Segments, events, and unknown gaps for one entity over a world interval

entries.name: entity.typed_row
entries.sql:
select e.id as entity_id, e.kind, e.display_name, e.slug, e.lifecycle, e.summary,
       ek.canonical_schema, ek.canonical_table,
       coalesce(
         to_jsonb(t_person), to_jsonb(t_organization), to_jsonb(t_product),
         to_jsonb(t_product_version), to_jsonb(t_product_feature), to_jsonb(t_ai_model),
         to_jsonb(t_ai_model_version), to_jsonb(t_model_offering), to_jsonb(t_technique),
         to_jsonb(t_dataset), to_jsonb(t_benchmark), to_jsonb(t_benchmark_run),
         to_jsonb(t_repository), to_jsonb(t_library), to_jsonb(t_library_release),
         to_jsonb(t_mcp_server), to_jsonb(t_agent_skill), to_jsonb(t_ai_protocol),
         to_jsonb(t_ai_protocol_version), to_jsonb(t_ai_protocol_feature), to_jsonb(t_paper),
         to_jsonb(t_media_channel), to_jsonb(t_media_series), to_jsonb(t_media_work),
         to_jsonb(t_event_series), to_jsonb(t_industry_event), to_jsonb(t_talk),
         to_jsonb(t_story), to_jsonb(t_case_study), to_jsonb(t_concept),
         to_jsonb(t_funding_round), to_jsonb(t_corporate_transaction), to_jsonb(t_registry),
         to_jsonb(t_security_advisory), to_jsonb(t_compute_device), to_jsonb(t_compute_offering)
       ) as typed_row
from corpus.entity e
join taxonomy.entity_kind ek on ek.code = e.kind
left join corpus.person t_person on t_person.id = e.id
left join corpus.organization t_organization on t_organization.id = e.id
left join corpus.product t_product on t_product.id = e.id
left join corpus.product_version t_product_version on t_product_version.id = e.id
left join corpus.product_feature t_product_feature on t_product_feature.id = e.id
left join corpus.ai_model t_ai_model on t_ai_model.id = e.id
left join corpus.ai_model_version t_ai_model_version on t_ai_model_version.id = e.id
left join corpus.model_offering t_model_offering on t_model_offering.id = e.id
left join corpus.technique t_technique on t_technique.id = e.id
left join corpus.dataset t_dataset on t_dataset.id = e.id
left join corpus.benchmark t_benchmark on t_benchmark.id = e.id
left join corpus.benchmark_run t_benchmark_run on t_benchmark_run.id = e.id
left join corpus.repository t_repository on t_repository.id = e.id
left join corpus.library t_library on t_library.id = e.id
left join corpus.library_release t_library_release on t_library_release.id = e.id
left join corpus.mcp_server t_mcp_server on t_mcp_server.id = e.id
left join corpus.agent_skill t_agent_skill on t_agent_skill.id = e.id
left join corpus.ai_protocol t_ai_protocol on t_ai_protocol.id = e.id
left join corpus.ai_protocol_version t_ai_protocol_version on t_ai_protocol_version.id = e.id
left join corpus.ai_protocol_feature t_ai_protocol_feature on t_ai_protocol_feature.id = e.id
left join corpus.paper t_paper on t_paper.id = e.id
left join corpus.media_channel t_media_channel on t_media_channel.id = e.id
left join corpus.media_series t_media_series on t_media_series.id = e.id
left join corpus.media_work t_media_work on t_media_work.id = e.id
left join corpus.event_series t_event_series on t_event_series.id = e.id
left join corpus.industry_event t_industry_event on t_industry_event.id = e.id
left join corpus.talk t_talk on t_talk.id = e.id
left join corpus.story t_story on t_story.id = e.id
left join corpus.case_study t_case_study on t_case_study.id = e.id
left join corpus.concept t_concept on t_concept.id = e.id
left join corpus.funding_round t_funding_round on t_funding_round.id = e.id
left join corpus.corporate_transaction t_corporate_transaction on t_corporate_transaction.id = e.id
left join corpus.registry t_registry on t_registry.id = e.id
left join corpus.security_advisory t_security_advisory on t_security_advisory.id = e.id
left join corpus.compute_device t_compute_device on t_compute_device.id = e.id
left join corpus.compute_offering t_compute_offering on t_compute_offering.id = e.id
where e.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and e.id = $1
  and ($2::text is null or e.kind = $2)
entries.title: Canonical entity plus the kind-dispatched typed child row

entries.name: entity.what_changed
entries.sql: select * from api.what_changed($1::uuid, $2::bigint, $3::bigint)
entries.title: Opened and closed items for one entity between two knowledge heads

entries.name: events.current_for_entity
entries.sql:
select event_id, kind, subject_entity_id, object_entity_id, occurrence_id,
       occurred_during, occurrence_mode, payload
from api.events_current
where subject_entity_id = $1
order by lower(occurred_during) desc, event_id
entries.title: Current event occurrences for one subject entity

entries.name: evidence.captures_for_source
entries.sql:
select sc.id, sc.source_id, sc.artifact_id, sc.content_sha256, sc.capture_method,
       sc.captured_at, sc.request_url
from evidence.source_capture sc
where sc.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and sc.source_id = $1
order by sc.captured_at desc, sc.id
entries.title: Captures registered for one source

entries.name: evidence.claim_support
entries.sql:
select ss.id, ss.segment_id, ss.event_occurrence_id, ss.claim_id, ss.locator_id,
       ss.role, ss.k_from, ss.k_to
from evidence.segment_support ss
where ss.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ss.claim_id = $1
order by ss.k_from, ss.id
entries.title: Segment and occurrence support rows for one claim

entries.name: evidence.claims_for_entity
entries.sql:
select c.id, c.claim_type, c.statement, c.status, c.created_at, cs.role
from evidence.claim c
join evidence.claim_subject cs on cs.claim_id = c.id and cs.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
where c.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and cs.entity_id = $1
order by c.created_at desc, c.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 100), 1), 200)
entries.title: Claims that name one entity as subject, object, or context

entries.name: evidence.sources_by_domain
entries.sql:
select s.id, s.canonical_url, s.registrable_domain, s.host, s.publisher_entity_id,
       s.last_seen_at, s.next_revisit_after
from evidence.source s
where s.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::text is null or s.registrable_domain = $1)
order by s.last_seen_at desc nulls last, s.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Sources filtered by registrable domain

entries.name: facts.current_by_stream
entries.sql:
select id, stream_id, stream_kind, subject_entity_id, subject_relationship_id, scope_key,
       valid_during, status, amount, currency, unit, belief, temporal_basis, k_from, k_to, payload
from api.current_facts
where ($1::text is null or stream_kind = $1)
  and ($2::uuid is null or subject_entity_id = $2)
order by stream_kind, scope_key, id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Current facts (k_to is null and valid_during contains now) by stream kind

entries.name: facts.history_for_stream
entries.sql:
select s.id, s.valid_during, s.k_from, s.k_to, s.status, s.amount, s.currency, s.unit,
       s.belief, s.temporal_basis, s.replaces_segment_id, st.scope_key
from temporal.segment s
join temporal.stream st on st.id = s.stream_id and st.tenant_id = s.tenant_id
where s.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and st.subject_entity_id = $1
  and st.kind = $2
  and st.scope_key = coalesce($3, '')
order by s.k_from, lower(s.valid_during)
limit least(greatest(coalesce($4, 50), 1), 200)
offset greatest(coalesce($5, 0), 0)
entries.title: All segments on one entity stream slot, including closed history

entries.name: knowledge.head
entries.sql: select knowledge_seq, updated_at from api.knowledge_head()
entries.title: Current tenant knowledge sequence

entries.name: receipts.for_intent
entries.sql:
select i.id as intent_id, i.intent_type, i.idempotency_key, i.approval_state, i.created_at,
       i.mission_id, b.knowledge_seq, b.receipt_id, b.recorded_at, b.summary
from orchestration.operation_intent i
left join temporal.knowledge_batch b
  on b.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and b.idempotency_key = i.idempotency_key
where i.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and i.id = $1
entries.title: Intent row and sealed batch for one operation intent

entries.name: receipts.recent_for_mission
entries.sql:
select i.id as intent_id, i.intent_type, i.approval_state, i.created_at, i.idempotency_key,
       b.knowledge_seq, b.receipt_id, b.recorded_at
from orchestration.operation_intent i
left join temporal.knowledge_batch b
  on b.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and b.idempotency_key = i.idempotency_key
where i.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and i.mission_id = $1
order by i.created_at desc, i.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 20), 1), 200)
entries.title: Recent intents and sealed batches for one mission

entries.name: relationships.current_by_kind
entries.sql:
select *
from api.current_relationships
where ($1::text is null or kind = $1)
  and ($2::uuid is null or from_entity_id = $2 or to_entity_id = $2)
order by kind, id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Current relationships, optionally filtered by kind or endpoint

entries.name: reports.artifacts
entries.sql: select r.role,a.* from research.report_artifact r join orchestration.artifact a on (a.tenant_id,a.id)=(r.tenant_id,r.artifact_id) where r.tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and r.report_version_id=$1::uuid order by r.role,a.id limit 200
entries.title: Registered report renditions and artifact metadata

entries.name: reports.assertions
entries.sql: select a.*, c.run_id, c.claim_key, c.claim_digest, c.claim_id, c.evidence_manifest_artifact_id, c.role from research.report_assertion a left join research.report_assertion_claim c on (c.tenant_id,c.report_version_id,c.assertion_id)=(a.tenant_id,a.report_version_id,a.id) where a.tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and a.report_version_id=$1::uuid order by a.start_utf16,a.id,c.run_id,c.claim_key,c.claim_digest,c.role limit 200
entries.title: Assertions and run-qualified evidence bindings

entries.name: reports.assessments
entries.sql: select * from research.report_assessment where tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and report_version_id=$1::uuid order by created_at,id limit 200
entries.title: Post-seal exact-byte assessment links

entries.name: reports.dependencies
entries.sql: select * from research.report_section_dependency where tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and report_version_id=$1::uuid order by section_id,required_version_id,required_section_id,relation limit 200
entries.title: Exact section revisions needed for reuse

entries.name: reports.ingestion_links
entries.sql: select * from research.report_ingestion_link where tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and report_version_id=$1::uuid order by created_at,id limit 200
entries.title: Report proposal receipts and canonical results

entries.name: reports.questions
entries.sql: select q.*, s.section_id from research.report_question q left join research.report_question_section s on (s.tenant_id,s.report_version_id,s.question_key)=(q.tenant_id,q.report_version_id,q.question_key) where q.tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and q.report_version_id=$1::uuid order by q.question_key,s.section_id limit 200
entries.title: Question coverage and answering sections

entries.name: reports.sections
entries.sql: select v.*, s.section_key from research.report_section_version v join research.report_section s on (s.tenant_id,s.report_id,s.id)=(v.tenant_id,v.report_id,v.section_id) where v.tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and v.report_version_id=$1::uuid order by v.ordinal limit 200
entries.title: Ordered sections with stable keys

entries.name: reports.versions
entries.sql: select v.*, p.schema_version, p.authoring_mode, p.as_of, p.predecessor_version_id, s.sealed_at from research.report_version v left join research.report_package p on (p.tenant_id,p.report_version_id)=(v.tenant_id,v.id) left join research.report_package_seal s on (s.tenant_id,s.report_version_id)=(v.tenant_id,v.id) where v.tenant_id=util.current_tenant_id() and v.report_id=$1::uuid order by v.version desc limit 200
entries.title: Versions and package status for a report

entries.name: retrieval.evidence_packet
entries.sql: select api.evidence_packet($1::uuid) as packet
entries.title: One evidence packet with members and node timecodes

entries.name: retrieval.hybrid_search
entries.sql: select * from api.hybrid_knowledge_search_1536($2::uuid, $3::text, $1::extensions.halfvec, $4::jsonb, $5::integer)
entries.title: Hybrid search over a published 1536-d vector-space version

entries.name: staging.candidates_for_kind
entries.sql:
select c.id, c.proposed_kind, c.proposed_payload, c.resolved_entity_id, c.source_id, c.created_at
from staging.candidate c
where c.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and ($1::text is null or c.proposed_kind = $1)
order by c.created_at desc, c.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($2, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Staging candidates of one proposed entity kind

entries.name: staging.unresolved
entries.sql:
select c.id, c.proposed_kind, c.proposed_payload, c.source_id, c.created_at
from staging.candidate c
where c.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()
  and c.resolved_entity_id is null
  and not exists (
    select 1 from staging.resolution_decision d
    where d.candidate_id = c.id and d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
      and d.decision in ('create', 'match', 'reject')
  )
order by c.created_at desc, c.id
limit least(greatest(coalesce($1, 50), 1), 200)
entries.title: Candidates with no create, match, or reject decision

entries.name: vocab.event_kind
entries.sql:
select code, subject_kinds, object_kinds, starts_stream_kind, ends_stream_kind, description
from temporal.event_kind
where ($1::text is null or code = $1)
order by code
entries.title: Event-kind vocabulary

entries.name: vocab.relationship_kind
entries.sql:
select code, from_kinds, to_kinds, temporal, "symmetric", inverse_label, description, property_schema
from taxonomy.relationship_kind
where ($1::text is null or code = $1)
order by code
entries.title: Relationship-kind vocabulary with endpoint constraints

entries.name: vocab.stream_kind
entries.sql:
select code, subject_mode, subject_kinds, status_values, requires_amount, unit_values,
       requires_ref_entity, ref_entity_kinds, payload_schema, description
from temporal.stream_kind
where ($1::text is null or code = $1)
order by code
entries.title: Stream-kind vocabulary and slot rules
